author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — REQ-3, REQ-9, AC-1 + decomposition PR 3.

## Surface
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/classifier/fanout.rs` — subscribes to the internal bus for firehose events, dispatches to configured classifiers, materializes `Observation` rows.
- New migration: `classifier_signals` table
  ```
  id UUID PK
  subject_id UUID REFERENCES subjects(id)
  classifier_name TEXT
  model_version TEXT
  label TEXT
  confidence DOUBLE PRECISION
  event_cid TEXT  -- ATProto record CID this classification refers to
  classified_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  ```
  Indexes: `(subject_id, classifier_name)` and `(classifier_name, classified_at)` for accuracy-tracking queries (Q3).
- New `polaris_types::ObservationKind::ClassifierSignal { model: String, label: String, confidence: f32 }` variant — additive enum extension.
- Config: `[[classifiers]] endpoint = "..." name = "..." weights = { spam = 0.9 }` blocks.

## Wellness interaction (REQ-9)
A `ClassifierSignal { label: "csam" | "graphic-violence" | …, confidence: > 0.9 }` is a routing input for the v1 §5.4 router. The fanout worker emits a `tracing::info!` event tagged `routing_input = "graphic_high_confidence"` so the v1 router can pick it up. The router code itself isn't in this PR — just the data flow.

## Rust-quality notes
- **Fan-out is independent of the pattern-engine subscriber.** Per design REQ-5: classifier slowness must NOT delay pattern detection. The fan-out task is a separate bus subscriber with its own consumer group.
- **One `tokio::task::JoinSet` per classifier** so per-classifier failure is isolated. Each classifier's task handles the per-permit semaphore acquire + tonic call.
- **Per rust-quality §10 cancel-safety**: the bus-poll branch + the per-classifier dispatch branches in `select!` must all be cancel-safe. Pin futures outside the select; pass `&mut fut` in.
- **Observation materialization is idempotent**: `INSERT … ON CONFLICT (event_cid, classifier_name) DO NOTHING` so a replayed bus event doesn't double-write.
- **Per rust-quality §3**: errors from `classifier.classify()` are logged at WARN with structured fields (`classifier = %name, event_cid = %cid, error = %e`) and DO NOT propagate up to the bus consumer — failures don't crash the worker.
- The trust-weight lookup is a simple `HashMap<String, f32>` per classifier, populated at startup from config. Per rust-quality §6: pre-compute, don't compute-per-event.

## External references
- v1 firehose-bus pattern in-repo: `polaris-backend/src/ingest/firehose.rs` + `polaris-backend/src/bus/`
- `tokio::task::JoinSet`: https://docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/task/struct.JoinSet.html
- sqlx `ON CONFLICT` patterns: https://docs.rs/sqlx/latest/sqlx/postgres/types/

## Acceptance (AC-1)
- [ ] Integration test against the FixtureClassifierClient (from PR 2) — fires a firehose event, fixture returns `{label: spam, confidence: 0.85}`, an `Observation` row appears in `classifier_signals` within 5s.
- [ ] AC-2 partial: fixture classifier disabled → no rows created, no error propagated.
